reference: Inflame: slower setup, smaller Strength gain, one-use attack.
Recover one exhausted card for 2 Energy with modest Block, then Exhaust; cannot recover itself.
Well-Laid Plans: pay 2 Energy to retain two cards; upgrade lowers setup cost.
Paid, one-use small heal and debuff removal; respects inherited healing and Hero Complex.
Bludgeon: lower damage unless the enemy is already at half HP; no Energy refund.
Twin Strike: two-Energy, three-hit, one-use attack with one turn of Weak; upgrade adds only one per hit.
Impervious: lower one-use Block budget, same two-Energy cost.
Offering: paid one-use recovery with smaller draw, small healing and no Energy gain.
Dark Embrace: paid one-card-per-Exhaust engine with four initial Block.
Offering: trades HP for Energy once; draws no cards.
Bludgeon: smaller repeatable damage budget, benefiting from bounded Arcane Charge.
One-use draw/charge setup banks next-turn Energy to play Arcane Flow draws; one fewer immediate card, upgrade adds one card and one delayed Energy.
Bullet Time: discounts only two random eligible cards by one, once, rather than freeing the hand.
Paid setup, one HP per turn for one extra card, plus one next-turn card; neither free nor HP-neutral.
Afterimage: triggers only every third Skill; paid setup includes modest initial Block.
One-Energy rare draw and Exhaust recovery, once; cannot recover cards with Exhaust-recovery effects.
Twin Strike: slower retained three-hit attack; per-hit upgrade stays at one.
Venom Reserve is a retained multiplier; Serpent Oil adds a small Poison seed before doubling, once. Its upgrade improves only the seed.
Zero Energy to select up to two discarded Attacks (three upgraded), then Exhaust. Selective recovery instead of Meditate-style draw and Energy.
Calculated Gamble: costs one Energy, offers modest Block; redraw excludes the played card.
Afterimage/Light Pack: paid two-Block discard engine with small initial defense.
Tracking Rhythm: slower setup with initial Vigor; subsequent Vigor only every third Attack.
Bash: smaller attack and one turn of Vulnerable at one Energy.
Caltrops: smaller recurring Thorns budget with modest initial Block.
Afterimage: fixed four end-turn Block instead of scaling with cards played; paid setup and modest initial defense.
Uppercut: smaller damage and one turn each of Weak and Vulnerable.
Paid one-use cleanse with modest Block; no healing or Energy refund.
Phoenix Forge: smaller per-Exhaust damage budget, supporting Mage exhaust recovery.
Prepared/Skim: one paid card with Scry selection, no immediate Energy gain or large draw burst.
Prepared/Bullet Time: paid, one-use draw and small random hand discount.
Afterimage: paid setup with modest initial Block; one Block per played card.
